_comment: Keys that start with an underscore are sentinels skipped by codegen, parity tests, and unused-key audit.

app.title: AI Gateway
app.description: Provider-neutral AI inference control plane for route decisions, evidence, and conformance.

dashboard.title: Gateway dashboard
dashboard.description: Provider readiness, recent route activity, policy gaps, and conformance debt in one operator view.
dashboard.noEvidence: No route evidence has been recorded yet.
dashboard.noFindings: No conformance findings returned for AI Gateway.

providers.title: Providers and roles
providers.description: Inspect roles exposed by resource command surfaces without turning AI Gateway into the concrete model catalog.
providers.empty: No provider roles were returned by the resource policies.
providers.smokeDescription: Run the provider-owned smoke command and display only normalized status.

routePreview.title: Route preview
routePreview.description: Test role, profile, privacy, and budget constraints before any inference execution.
routePreview.empty: Submit a preview to inspect candidates and policy reasons.
routePreview.selectedRouteDescription: Preview results are provider-neutral and keep execution separate.

conformance.title: AI conformance
conformance.description: Run deterministic scans for unsafe provider usage, migration gaps, model assumptions, and exception drift.
conformance.initial: Run a scan to inspect findings, maturity level, and migration recommendations.
conformance.empty: No findings returned for this scan.

settings.title: Policies and settings
settings.description: Review operator defaults for privacy, evidence retention, provider smoke behavior, theme, and locale.
settings.privacyDefaultDetail: Used when callers omit an explicit privacy class.
settings.evidenceRetentionDetail: Evidence remains metadata-only; prompts and responses are not stored.
settings.smokeBeforeExecuteDetail: Require provider readiness checks before operator-triggered execution.

health.title: API Health
health.error: Unable to reach the API. Make sure the scenario is running through `vrooli scenario start`.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.message: An unexpected error occurred while rendering the page. Try again, or reload if the problem persists.
